blocks.text: Leviticus 5 identifies cases requiring confession and a sin offering, including failure to testify, ritual uncleanness, and rash oaths. It provides offerings scaled to means, from a female lamb or goat to birds or flour, and adds regulations for trespass involving holy things or deception. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Ancient Near Eastern ritual comparisons illuminate vocabulary and practice but do not establish that Israelite rites carried the same theology or were directly borrowed.
